title: Axiom SLOC Evidence Record
description: Schema for ratified SLOC evidence records used in the EffectiveSLOC governance corpus.

fixture_source.description: The exact source string the evidence measures; used to re-create the semantic observation during verification

fixture_raw_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the raw fixture source string bytes

metric.description: Which SLOC metric this record measures

context.description: WhenContext for effectiveSloc records; null for sourceSloc

expected_result.description: Ratified expected value (int for sourceSloc/effectiveSloc Ok, object with error for effectiveSloc Err)

observed_result.description: Current implementation result (int for success, err:string for error); separates provenance from expected_result

observed_facts.description: Observations from sourceSlocOf/effectiveSlocOf: span intervals, branch selections, or error reasons

policy_refs.description: Policy rule IDs from sloc_policy_registry.json that govern this record
